tools.name: list_canonical_metrics
tools.title: List canonical metrics
tools.description: List the reviewed canonical health metric definitions (code, display name, domain, canonical unit, cadence, priority, interpretation tier). Reference metadata only — no physiological values and no clinical thresholds.

domain.description: Optional domain filter, e.g. laboratory or nutrition_hydration.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match on code or display name.

limit.description: Maximum definitions to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: list_my_missions
tools.title: List my missions
tools.description: List the missions the signed-in user is an active member of, with their mission role. Scoped by mission row-level security — never returns other users' missions.

tools.name: list_mission_events
tools.title: List mission events
tools.description: List recorded mission event metadata (kind, timestamp, source, data classification) the signed-in user is authorized to read. Returns record metadata only, never raw physiological values, and never interprets or diagnoses.

missionId.description: Optional mission id filter; defaults to every authorized mission.

limit.description: Maximum events to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: get_mission_snapshot
tools.title: Get ground mission snapshot
tools.description: Return the governed ground-console snapshot for one mission via the existing authorization-checked database function. Denied unless the signed-in user holds an authorized ground mission role.
